title: pteris collina var. nobilis
intro: Pteris collina var. nobilis, commonly known as the noble climbing fern, is a plant species in the family Pteridaceae. It is a type of fern that has been traditionally used in medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pteris collina var. nobilis include wound healing, anti-aging, and the treatment of various diseases such as fever and rheumatism. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to have potential in the development of new medicines.
